mapper.insert: insert ignore into one_line_strategy_ai_daily_run( generation_date, api_call_count, last_status, input_tokens, output_tokens, search_query_count ) values(#{generationDate}, 0, 'IDLE', 0, 0, 0)
mapper.update: update one_line_strategy_ai_daily_run set api_call_count = api_call_count + 1, last_status = 'RUNNING', last_attempt_at = now(), completed_at = null, last_error = null where generation_date = #{generationDate} and api_call_count < #{maxDailyApiCalls} and ( last_status in ('IDLE', 'FAILED', 'SUCCESS') or (last_status = 'RUNNING' and last_attempt_at < #{staleBefore}) )
mapper.select: select generation_date, api_call_count, last_status, last_attempt_at, completed_at, last_error, input_tokens, output_tokens, search_query_count from one_line_strategy_ai_daily_run where generation_date = #{generationDate}
select count(*) from one_line_strategy_ai_draft where status = 'PENDING'
select slot_no from one_line_strategy_ai_draft where generation_date = #{generationDate} order by slot_no
mapper.insert: insert into one_line_strategy_ai_draft( generation_date, slot_no, category, content, evidence_summary, source_board, source_post_num, source_title, source_excerpt, external_source_url, external_source_title, external_evidence_summary, model, status, created_at ) values( #{generationDate}, #{slotNo}, #{category}, #{content}, #{evidenceSummary}, #{sourceBoard}, #{sourcePostNum}, #{sourceTitle}, #{sourceExcerpt}, #{externalSourceUrl}, #{externalSourceTitle}, #{externalEvidenceSummary}, #{model}, 'PENDING', now() )
mapper.sql: d.draft_id, d.generation_date, d.slot_no, d.category, c.name as category_name, d.content, d.evidence_summary, d.source_board, d.source_post_num, d.source_title, d.source_excerpt, d.external_source_url, d.external_source_title, d.external_evidence_summary, d.model, d.status, d.created_at, d.reviewed_at, d.reviewed_by, d.published_tip_num
mapper.select: select from one_line_strategy_ai_draft d join one_line_strategy_category c on c.code = d.category where d.status = 'PENDING' order by d.created_at asc, d.draft_id asc

select from one_line_strategy_ai_draft d join one_line_strategy_category c on c.code = d.category where d.status in ('APPROVED', 'REJECTED') order by d.reviewed_at desc, d.draft_id desc limit #{limit}
select from one_line_strategy_ai_draft d join one_line_strategy_category c on c.code = d.category where d.draft_id = #{draftId} and d.status = 'PENDING'
select from one_line_strategy_ai_draft d join one_line_strategy_category c on c.code = d.category where d.draft_id = #{draftId}
mapper.update: update one_line_strategy_ai_draft set category = #{category}, content = #{content}, status = 'APPROVED', published_tip_num = #{publishedTipNum} where draft_id = #{draftId} and status = 'APPROVING'
mapper.select: select recent.content from ( select content, reg_date as occurred_at from one_line_strategy union all select content, created_at as occurred_at from one_line_strategy_ai_draft where status in ('PENDING', 'REJECTED') ) recent order by recent.occurred_at desc limit #{limit}
select content from one_line_strategy order by reg_date desc, tip_num desc limit #{limit}

select post_num, title, content, writer, reg_date, views, comment_count, recommend_count, notice from ${boardTitle} where notice = 0 and content is not null and trim(content) != '' order by recommend_count desc, views desc, reg_date desc, post_num desc limit #{limit}
